name: Xinxing Ductile Iron Pipes Co., Ltd.
summary: Xinxing Ductile Iron Pipes Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, provides cast iron pipes and steel in China and internationally. The company offers hot-rolled ribbed steel bars, cold-heading steel, gear steel, tool and die steel, and axle steel; ductile iron pipe fittings for various interface types and pressure ratings; and steel-plastic composite pipes, special steel pipes, stainless steel pipes, and fittings.
